title: My Company Of One Story - Episode 3 The Transition
content:
<html><head></head><body>Welcome to this new blog-series of mine where I want to invite you to follow my path as one-man-company. I want to share with you how I survive working on my own, freelancing, building products, and how I try to follow my business dreams. This is episode number three, where I talk about my transition from being employed to become self-employed.
            </body></html>
author: Christoph Rumpel Blog Feed
